## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 8, 2026 - Jul 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Neil Harris_, Jul 4, 2026, 5/5: "I've been using Blush for a while now & I have to give it a solid 5 stars. There was a technical issue recently, but that's been resolved now. I've tried similar apps. In some ways, Blush beats them all. It offers a lot, even if you use it for free. A great range of characters. & if that's not enough, you can create your own, with detailed backstories, if you wish. Blush tops up your credit a bit each day, so you can easily afford to get customised profile pictures made for the characters."
            2. _Matthias Döring_, Jun 8, 2026, 5/5: "I have been using the app for months and have gone through development over many versions. The app gets better with every update. Some things don't work the way they should or haven't been implemented yet, but in the Blush Discord you can actively help improve the app and report bugs, which are quickly fixed. I love the pre-made characters & the pictures they send, but lately I've been having more fun creating my own characters with the AI."
